doc: Preregistration for M3 iterations (docs/BUILD_PLAN.md §0.1). One key per iteration under iterations. A key is written once, in its prereg commit, before any of its outcome_paths change; holon audit prereg checks the order and that the key is never edited afterwards. predictions count toward prediction accuracy; regressions are outcomes already recorded in the repo that must not change.

predictions.claim: A fixture proof that edits its law file is refused by G1: with tests_m3/fixtures/intake/proofs/edits_law/LAWS.bend written over gen/T41/laws/L_i41_x_any_act/LAWS.bend (the claim added as a premise h, the generated header kept) and edits_law/PROOF.bend in the inbox, Bend alone accepts the proof against the edited file, and holon intake refuses it with reason law_file_changed, differs == [gen/T41/laws/L_i41_x_any_act/LAWS.bend], no kernel run, the edited file left in place.

A valid fixture agent proof is accepted and labelled: proofs/valid/PROOF.bend, a hand-written Reach induction (strengthening y == 0) for L_i41_x_any_act (forall s: Reach, a: Act. x_zero(s) == true; UNKNOWN by the generators because reach_invariant refuses its second binder, the same refusal as the two real UNKNOWN M2 laws), is accepted by holon intake with bend2 and bendtt checked, lean4 not applicable and G1 clean; after holon run --milestone T41 its record is PROVED with prover agent:fixture-i41, artifacts.proof gen/T41/proofs/L_i41_x_any_act/PROOF.bend byte-identical to the inbox file, artifacts.laws the generators' statement with the unchanged statement hash, kernels bend2 and bendtt checked, independence_class I1-shared, bound null, non_vacuity inhabited (gen/T41/L_i41_x_any_act/nonvac/LAWS.bend, reachable), the generators' attempts kept and one intake attempt last; the record differs from the generators' UNKNOWN record in exactly status, prover, artifacts, attempts, bound, checker, kernel, kernels, independence_class and non_vacuity; the run adds exactly 4 gen/T41 files (law, proof copy, 2 inhabitant files); the L_i41_y and L_i41_flag records and every earlier gen/T41 file are unchanged.

The gate re-decides the agent proof from scratch: on the accepted T41 tree holon gate --milestone T41 --checks G1,G3,G5,G7,G9,G11,G11V passes (at baseline it passes with 2 proofs, 3 records, 1 premised PROVED law inhabited); G1 regenerates the agent-proved record from the committed inbox (3 records identical), G5 and G7 each re-check 3 proofs (the 2 generator proofs and the agent's), G9 validates 3 records with prover, and G11V inhabits 2 premised PROVED laws. Negative control: with the inbox file replaced by the wrong proof (y == 1) and the accepted records and gen/T41 left in place, G1 fails and names L_i41_x_any_act among the records that differ.

Proofs for laws the generators PROVED or REFUTED are refused not_unknown before any kernel: the fixture's L_i41_y (its own generator proof, which Bend accepts) and L_i41_flag, and every decided M2 law resubmitted with its committed proof (at f8fa447: 8, 6 PROVED including L_sort_site_rollup_441_b4cd5068 and 2 REFUTED including L_sort_site_rollup_363_1fc7f88a).

Escape hatches are refused escape_hatch, naming their class, before G1 and before any kernel: ?TODO and ?name (hole), @unsafe (unsafe), def f?(..) (unsafe_sugar) and import "./ag.c" (foreign_import), each added to the valid fixture proof; and a ?TODO proof for each UNKNOWN M2 law (at f8fa447 L_sort_site_def_lci_356891e4 and L_sort_site_l1messagequeuewithgaspriceoracle_325_f89daf17), which shows both are eligible.

A proof that checks but lacks the expected law is refused: proofs/no_law/PROOF.bend (the whole induction as a plain def, no law imported) gets ALL PROOFS CHECK from Bend and missing_expected_law from the intake, before any kernel.

An over-budget proof is refused: the valid proof plus a true lemma that makes 2^28 calls (ag_walk(28)), under --budget-s 10, is refused over_budget with bend2 timed out (killed at the budget: seconds >= 10, and the CLI returns within 130 s), while the valid proof alone is accepted under the same budget.

The real M2 path reaches the kernel: for each UNKNOWN M2 law a proof filled with {==} passes every check before the kernels, including G1 over gen/M2 (the regenerated model, core and law files equal the committed ones: differs == []), and is refused kernel_rejected with bend2 failed; the CLI changes no tracked M2 file.

A refused submission changes nothing but its target's attempts: with the wrong strengthening (y == 1) in the inbox, holon run --milestone T41 leaves L_i41_x_any_act UNKNOWN with prover generator and one more attempt (intake, refused, kernel_rejected), every other field and record as the generators left them, and gen/T41 byte-identical to the generators' run.

predictions.claim: The PAR cycle basis of the one M3 diagram, gen/M3/diagram/header_length.json (the linked codec component of I19's link role header_length over the extracted documents spec/M3/lib/derive_extracted.json adopts; TRANS, CODEC and HASH edges over every carrier, BFS rule P8), has exactly |E|-|V|+kappa = 20-17+1 = 4 elements, as spec/M3/lib/par_basis.json computed at the prereg: the non-tree edges CODEC.BatchHeaderBytes_BlobHashesHash, CODEC.BatchHeaderBytes_BlobVersionedHash, CODEC.BatchHeaderV1_Bytes and CODEC.load_sol. DERIVATION.json cycle_rank is {header_length: the sidecar's cycle}, and none of the 4 adds a law: the two blob getters' cycles (against the tree edge BlobCommitHash) restate the three PAR-weak laws at their common versions (rule X8c: BlobHashesHash at 2, BlobVersionedHash at 0 and 1; recorded as the duplicates L_par_cy_BatchHeaderBytes_BlobHashesHash_v2, L_par_cy_BatchHeaderBytes_BlobVersionedHash_v0 and _v1), the V1 encoder and the version-2 patch share no version ({1} and {2}: no_common_version), and load_sol's self-loop is not_a_parallel_pair. No TRANS edge enters the basis: the extracted transitions document has no M3 diagram (gap G1).

holon derive --milestone M3 emits exactly the 80 PAR laws spec/M3/lib/par_basis.json lists, all over the linked codec document gen/M3/codec/header_length.json and none from a hand document (Q19): 70 round trip, one per E1 inverse atom (enc_sol 11/12/12 at versions 0/1/2, BatchHeaderV0_Bytes 11, BatchHeaderV1_Bytes 12, the version-2 patch BatchCache_createBatchHeaderWithSequencerSetHash 12); 6 cross-component (each Go encoder against enc_sol at its one version, full and pinned, the pin SequencerSetVerifyHash = 32 zero bytes); 3 PAR-weak (rule X8c, one per common version under the tag premise BatchHeaderBytes_Version(b) = Some(v): BlobCommitHash with BlobHashesHash at version 2, with BlobVersionedHash at versions 0 and 1); 1 domain coherence (L_par_dom_BatchHeaderBytes_validate_ok_load_sol). No branch, totality, cycle, recompute, consumer or init law; the only reasons recorded are totality explicit_option x15, weak no_common_version x2 (BlobHashesHash with BlobVersionedHash, the patch with the V1 encoder), cycle no_common_version x1 and not_a_parallel_pair x1 (besides the three cycle duplicates).

Every sub-form generator produces its fixture law and each decides as designed (the ten tests_m3/fixtures/par_<subform>.facts.json and the linked fixture tests_m3/fixtures/par_linked/, derived together as T24 under holon-rules/1.1 and run): round_trip L_par_rt_enc_rt_sol_dec_rt_v0 REFUTED (b != 0), _pinned PROVED; cross_component L_par_cc_enc_cc_go_enc_cc_sol_v0 REFUTED (b != 0), _pinned PROVED, L_par_rt_enc_cc_go_dec_cc_v0 PROVED, L_par_rt_enc_cc_sol_dec_cc_v0 REFUTED, _pinned PROVED; branch L_par_br_enc_br_fast_enc_br_slow_v1 REFUTED (b != 0); weak L_par_weak_enc_wk_go_enc_wk_sol_v0 REFUTED (a != b), levels [E6], intent_question; domain L_par_dom_ok_dm_go_ok_dm_sol REFUTED (version 0, length > 5); totality L_par_tot_dec_tt REFUTED; cycle L_par_cy_dec_cy_sol REFUTED; recompute L_par_rc_reput_put_enc_held REFUTED (held != 0 and != enc(v)); consumer L_par_cs_feed_post_dig_com1 PROVED, L_par_cs_feed_post_dig_com2 REFUTED (post with keep); init L_par_init_pop_g0 REFUTED, L_par_init_sync_g0 PROVED. predictions.claim: All 70 round trips are PROVED (every BatchHeaderBytes getter accepts the length and version byte each encoder writes, 249 at version 0 and 257 at versions 1 and 2, and reads the field it recovers). The 3 unpinned cross-component laws L_par_cc_BatchHeaderV0_Bytes_enc_sol_v0, L_par_cc_BatchHeaderV1_Bytes_enc_sol_v1 and L_par_cc_BatchCache_createBatchHeaderWithSequencerSetHash_enc_sol_v2 are REFUTED, each by a Go header whose SequencerSetVerifyHash is nonzero (enc_sol writes 32 zero bytes at 185..216) and a Solidity header of the law's version that enc_sol stores (prevStateHash and postStateHash nonzero, rule X9). The 3 _pinned laws are PROVED and inhabited, among them the version-2 law of the Go patch: the extracted version-2 Go encoding agrees with enc_sol, where M0's L_par_hdr_v2 over the hand enc_go_v1 (writing version 1) is REFUTED (O2).

The byte-string laws are decided at probes (rule X9): L_par_dom_BatchHeaderBytes_validate_ok_load_sol is REFUTED by a byte string whose byte 0 is 0 and whose length exceeds 249 (O1: Solidity's loader accepts length >= 249 at version 0, Go's validate exactly 249). The three PAR-weak laws L_par_weak_BatchHeaderBytes_BlobCommitHash_BatchHeaderBytes_BlobHashesHash_v2 and L_par_weak_BatchHeaderBytes_BlobCommitHash_BatchHeaderBytes_BlobVersionedHash_v0 and _v1 are UNKNOWN, their records naming the probe bound and carrying no witness: under the tag premise both getters accept the same (length, tag) pairs (257 at version 2; 249 at version 0; 257 at version 1) and read the same bytes 57..88, so no probe refutes them, and a byte-string law has no proof route (gap G6, whitepaper §8.4's case split on length and version is not built). Unscoped, both pairs would be REFUTED by a header of a version outside one getter's label; rule X8c (common versions only, never widened) rules that instantiation out.

holon backtest --milestone M3 (rules B1-B5 over the frozen name map spec/M3/lib/backtest_map.json: collapse, then alpha-equivalence) pairs 4 of the 8 M0 laws and accepts every pairing: L_par_hdr_v0 -> L_par_cc_BatchHeaderV0_Bytes_enc_sol_v0_pinned, L_par_hdr_v1 -> L_par_cc_BatchHeaderV1_Bytes_enc_sol_v1_pinned and L_par_hdr_ssvh -> L_par_cc_BatchHeaderV1_Bytes_enc_sol_v1 by bridges (each hand encoder equals its extracted image, Bend-checked); L_dom_hdr -> L_par_dom_BatchHeaderBytes_validate_ok_load_sol by witness transfer (both REFUTED; the M3 counter-witness refutes the M0 law on the hand model). L_par_hdr_v2 (the image of the hand enc_go_v1 carries version 1 only; candidates L_par_cc_BatchHeaderV1_Bytes_enc_sol_v1 and _pinned) and L_rt_go_v0, L_rt_go_v1, L_rt_go_v2 (dec_go and view have no image) are open rule gaps (G5). results/M3/backtest.json is complete and its exit_blockers are exactly gap:M0:L_par_hdr_v2, gap:M0:L_rt_go_v0, gap:M0:L_rt_go_v1 and gap:M0:L_rt_go_v2, so M3 exit cannot be claimed until I45 closes them.

Every M3 PAR record carries the status, evidence levels and triage spec/M3/lib/par_basis.json lists (levels as law_evidence computes them over gen/M3/evidence.json, the tag premise read as the version premise): the 70 round trips [E1, E2], the 6 cross-component laws [E1], the 3 PAR-weak laws [E6], the domain law []. Statuses: 73 PROVED, 4 REFUTED, 3 UNKNOWN. The REFUTED laws are 4 findings (the 3 unpinned cross-component laws and the domain law) and no Morph law is an intent question (the E6-only laws are UNKNOWN, I24-P5): evidence_triage counts none 76, finding 4.
